description: Run supply-chain-guard's full static malware scan (350+ detection rules: obfuscation, install hooks, C2 indicators, lockfile tampering, CI/CD abuse) over a local directory. Local filesystem only. Returns a compact JSON summary with risk score, findings count by severity, and the top findings.

minSeverity.description: Only report findings at or above this severity (optional)

since.description: Only scan files changed since this git commit/ref (optional diff scan): a branch, tag or SHA such as 'main', 'v1.2.3' or 'a1b2c3d', optionally followed by ~N or ^N (for example 'HEAD~1'). Reflog ('@{1}') and range syntax are not accepted.

name: scan_directory
